mapper.select: SELECT r.review_id, r.sale_item_id, r.user_id, r.rating, r.review_comment, r.created_time, r.updated_time, r.views, r.seller_comment, s.title as product_title, u.user_name as customer_name FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN sales s ON r.sale_item_id = s.sale_item_id LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.user_id = #{buyerId} ORDER BY r.created_time DESC
